record.synthesis_method: topochemical ion-exchange of Na2Ni2TeO6 with molten AgNO3
record.evidence_quote: was found to be 4.88 × 10−4 S cm−1 at 30 ◦ C and 2.39 × 10−2 S cm−1 at 100 ◦ C.
record.notes: Mobile ion is Ag+. Lowest-temperature value (30 C) recorded; the 100 C value 2.39 × 10−2 S cm−1 is omitted per the series rule. Activation energy 0.57 eV is from fitting 30-100 C data, quoted in the results section ('activation energy of about 0.57 eV'). Pellet compactness ~84% per results and Methods. Sintering fields null because pellets were cold-pressed (about 40 MPa) and not sintered; 250 C is the ion-exchange temperature, not a sintering temperature.

record.synthesis_method: topochemical ion-exchange of Na2Mg2TeO6 with molten AgNO3
record.evidence_quote: displays a predominant ionic conductivity of 1.77 × 10−6 S cm−1 at 30 ◦ C
record.notes: Mobile ion is Ag+. Lowest-temperature value recorded; the 100 C value 3.84 × 10−4 S cm−1 is omitted per the series rule. No activation energy is given for this composition. Pellet density ~74% of theoretical per results and Methods. The Ni composition is written as Ag2Ni2TeO6 in the paper; the Mg row is from the same measurement set.
